full_judgment: 4. After the closing of the pleadings issues were framed and parties led their evidence. The learned SCC Judge by a judgment and decree dated 18-9-85 dismissed the suit. Against the said judgment and decree the plaintiffs filed Miscellaneous Case No. 54 of 1985 under Order 47 rule 1 of the Code of Civil Procedure and the learned SCC Judge by his judgment and order dated 22-6-86 set aside the judgment and decree dated 18-9-85 and decreed the suit against the defendants and ordered for khas possession of the suit premises by evicting the defendants therefrom. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and order the defendant petitioners preferred this application and obtained the instant Rule.
